verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any AI capability that reads incoming bills and auto-fills payment details for review. The Bills API only lets you create and manage vendor invoices through the API. AgentOS is described as acting on balances, beneficiaries, cards and reports, not extracting data from bills. These are developer building blocks, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI read incoming bills and auto-populate payment details for my review
